[SWS_LinIf_00075] ⌈The LIN Interface shall call the function PduR_LinTp-
StartOfReception with an info pointer and TpSduLength when the start of a
TP message reception is indicated by the reception of a FF or a SF.
info is pointer to the buffer containing the received data (SduDataPtr) and data
length (SduLength). The data length (including SID) is 5 bytes for FF and up to 6
bytes for SF. TpSduLength is the total length of the Sdu.⌋
The output pointer parameter provides the LIN Interface with currently available receive
buffer size.
